<thought>Based on the limited data (C6H9O2, one carbonyl, four aromatic‑type carbons, six distinct carbon environments, no CH₃ groups), the most straightforward way to “link the fragments” is to break the molecule into the basic functional‑group fragments that are present: a carbonyl fragment and an unsaturated carbon fragment. Representing these as SMILES gives “C=O” for the carbonyl and “C=C” for the unsaturated part, with an additional single‑bond carbon “C” to complete the carbon count.</thought>
<final_answer>['C=O', 'C=C', 'C']</final_answer>
